articles.headline: Belgian FA won't back Infantino's FIFA reelection, cites Balogun red card ban U-turn
articles.description: The Belgian football federation said it can't support Gianni Infantino's bid for another term as FIFA president, citing transparency and governance issues and the way FIFA handled clearing Folarin Balogun from a mandatory one-game ban at the World Cup.
